need half a teaspoon of Salon cinnamon this is for blood sugar liver and pancreas Health a teaspoon of ground flax seeds for omega-3 Digestive and heart health 1 teaspoon of sunflower lethin for phospholipids and as a safe choline Source 2 tpoon of ground walnuts for omega-3 and brain health next add a/4 cup of berries for antioxidants and polyphenol for cognition and three re cherries for anti-inflammatory sleep and joint health for berries choose between strawberries raspberries blackberries or blueberries then add 3 tablespoons of

ground macadamia nuts for healthy fats and Omega 9 one4 of a Brazil nut for selenium and pour in 50 to 100 ml of nutmilk depending upon what consistency you like I prefer 50 mlit finish with 60 mL of pomegranate juice for antioxidants and heart health finally transfer everything into a blender mix on high for about 2 minutes until foamy pour into a dish and assemble your toppings 2 tbsp of chia seeds for omega-3 and fiber 30 to 60 G of pea
protein and finally 1/4 cup of berries the saddest moment of my day is the last bite of nutty pudding let's be sad together
